study type: Methodology description / Intervention adaptation study (part of a randomized trial)
exposure: Adaptation process of a U.S.-based evidence-based intervention (4Rs and 2Ss content) for disruptive behavior disorders
outcome: Description of similarities and differences between original and adapted intervention content and methods of delivery
Insights into the importance of involving community stakeholders in the adaptation process
cohort: The study participants for the randomized trial include youth exhibiting behavioral challenges and their caregivers across 30 schools in Uganda.
finding: The adaptation process highlighted similarities and differences between the original and adapted intervention content and delivery methods, emphasizing the importance of community stakeholder involvement.
